facts: MUL_MAT_ID supports Q1_0,Q2_0,Q2_K,Q3_K,Q4_K,Q5_K,Q6_K,Q4_0,Q4_1,Q8_0,IQ4_NL,MXFP4 subject to type/layout/block constraints.
SSM_CONV is mapped to HTP and has a solver; inputs, convolution weights and output must be F32; kernel length 1..32 and dimensional/stride/VTCM restrictions apply.
No GGML_OP_SSM_SCAN mapping in this complete source file.

current_runtime_source_evidence.interpretation: Operator support increases plausibility of partial Hexagon acceleration, but is not full-model support, numeric accuracy, memory peak or speed evidence. Absence of SSM_SCAN mapping indicates non-HTP scheduling is required for the normal Granite Mamba2 scan graph.
current_runtime_source_evidence.memory_rule: Active parameters reduce per-token selected computation. They do not shrink all resident experts to active parameter count. GGUF file bytes exclude KV/recurrent state, activation buffers, backend staging/repacking, vision model and Android/App working memory.
